# Panorama tests distinguish the database service from its folder table interface

Entry 1501 renames local test roles so database is the shared service/SQL access and folders is the folder API. Current head.js uses database, folderDB and messageDB, making each layer explicit. Proposed naming rule in these tests: name the service and table interfaces by their role and use testVerb task names such as testInsertRoot or testReconcile. Keep test_insert.js/test_reconcile.js filenames and fixture db/*.sql conventions; do not impose this mixed filename/task casing on the entire project. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.

Scope: Panorama test naming.
